name: Basic Securities Registration
definition: Information related to registration of securities.

RegistrationInstruction.name: Registration Instruction
RegistrationInstruction.definition: Specifies whether registration should occur upon receipt.

CertificationDate.name: Certification Date
CertificationDate.definition: Date/time at which the certificates in the deposit were validated by the agent.

Security.name: Security
Security.definition: Security for which registration information is provided.

SecuritiesCertificate.name: Securities Certificate
SecuritiesCertificate.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of a certificate assigned by the issuer.

SplitPeriod.name: Split Period
SplitPeriod.definition: Period during which a physical certificate can be split.
